title: CRAFFT+N Questionnaire
intro: Please answer all questions honestly; your answers will be kept confidential.
noteAllZero: If you answer <1>"0 days"</1> (no use) to <3>all</3> of the <5>PART A QUESTIONS</5>, please proceed to answer <7>only the first question</7> in Part B ("Car").
noteAnyMore: If you answer <1>1 day or more</1> to <3>any</3> of the <5>PART A QUESTIONS</5>, please continue to answer <7>all 6 CRAFFT questions</7> in Part B (<9>Car, Relax, Alone, Forget, Family/Friends, Trouble</9>).
question1: 1. During the <1>PAST 12 MONTHS</1>, on how many days did you drink more than a few sips of beer, wine, or any drink containing alcohol?
question2: 2. During the <1>PAST 12 MONTHS</1>, on how many days did you use any marijuana (cannabis, weed, oil, wax, or hash by smoking, vaping, dabbing, or in edibles) or "synthetic marijuana" (like "K2," "Spice")?
question3: 3. During the <1>PAST 12 MONTHS</1>, on how many days did you use any anything else to get high (like other illegal drugs, pills, prescription or over-the-counter medications, and things that you sniff, huff, vape, or inject)?
question4: 4. During the <1>PAST 12 MONTHS</1>, on how many days did you use a vaping device containing nicotine and/or flavors, or use any tobacco products?
question4Note: Such as e-cigs, mods, pod devices like JUUL, disposable vapes like Puff Bar, vape pens, e-hookahs, cigarettes, cigars, cigarillos, hookahs, chewing tobacco, snuff, snus, dissolvables, or nicotine pouches.
car: 1. Have you ever ridden in a <1>CAR</1> driven by someone (including yourself) who was "high" or had been using alcohol or drugs?
relax: 2. Do you ever use alcohol or drugs to <1>RELAX</1>, feel better about yourself, or fit in?
alone: 3. Do you ever use alcohol or drugs while you are by yourself, or <1>ALONE</1>?
forget: 4. Do you ever <1>FORGET</1> things you did while using alcohol or drugs?
family: 5. Do your <1>FAMILY or FRIENDS</1> ever tell you that you should cut down on your drinking or drug use?
trouble: 6. Have you ever gotten into <1>TROUBLE</1> while you were using alcohol or drugs?
toastRequired: Please fill in all required fields!
